capabilities: Chat with AI using notes as context
Run a tool-calling agent that reads and edits vault files
Generate summaries, rewrites and inline completions
Index notes for semantic vault search
Schedule recurring agent tasks and lifecycle hooks
extras: MCP support is marked experimental; requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later; API keys are stored via Obsidian SecretStorage; a free Gemini API tier is available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI layer for chatting with notes, editing them through an agent, or automating AI tasks.

relations.evidence: OpenAI (cloud) — requires your own OpenAI API key
Anthropic (cloud) — requires your own Anthropic API key
OpenRouter (cloud) — requires your own OpenRouter API key

summary: AI assistant that connects Obsidian to Gemini, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter for chat, vault-aware agents, summaries, rewrites and completions.
